title: Tour: reactionapp.life
intro: A short look at reactionapp.life in screenshots of the site itself, with our own words for each one. Nothing here is sent anywhere.

steps.say: Screenshots only, nothing is sent. Watch anything. Keep your best reactions. Reaction videos, made by you and your people.

Watch longer content and get a highlight reel of your strongest reactions. The camera records your face and the screen records what you watch. You choose the moments to keep, then post, save, or send them.
The heart of the app is a public board of reactions that people choose to share. Every one can be reacted to, and the thread grows. This site is still in progress.
